picks.name: Buka Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Buka Restaurant is the most widely cited jollof stop for visitors in Accra at roughly ₵40-₵100 per plate, with a polished Osu setting that makes it the easiest 'famous first stop' for travelers.
picks.whatToOrder: Order the jollof with chicken or fish and pay attention to the balance between tomato richness and smoke rather than just spice level.
picks.insiderTip: Go expecting a known-name restaurant, not a secret local bargain, and use it as a baseline before trying less polished spots.

redditQuotes.quote: Buka is the one most visitors hear about first, but locals will still argue over whether it is actually the best.

picks.name: Asanka Local
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Asanka Local is one of the stronger value plays for jollof in Accra at around ₵25-₵60, with a more grounded local-food feel than the polished tourist headline spots in Osu.
picks.whatToOrder: Get jollof with a protein and compare the seasoning and portion against Buka rather than treating them as interchangeable picks.
picks.insiderTip: This is the sort of place that helps separate 'famous online' from 'actually satisfying at lunch.'

redditQuotes.quote: If you want a less touristy comparison point, Asanka Local is the more useful benchmark.

picks.name: Street Jollof (Osu Night Market)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Street jollof around Osu Night Market is the cheapest serious jollof option in Accra at roughly ₵10-₵25, and it matters because many locals trust busy roadside vendors more than high-visibility restaurant brands.
picks.whatToOrder: Order a freshly served plate with protein and judge it on smokiness, rice texture, and whether the pot tastes like it was made for regulars rather than tourists.
picks.insiderTip: High turnover matters more than branding here; if a stall is quiet and the food looks tired, move on.

redditQuotes.quote: The best jollof may not be the prettiest one on Google Images.

faq.question: Where is the best jollof rice in Accra?
faq.answer: Buka is the most famous visitor-facing answer, but the better honest answer is that Accra has a split between polished known restaurants and busy roadside vendors that many locals trust more.

faq.question: How much does jollof rice cost in Accra?
faq.answer: Street plates can start around ₵10-₵25, while restaurant servings often land around ₵40-₵100 depending on venue and protein.

faq.question: Is street jollof in Accra worth trying?
faq.answer: Yes, if turnover is high and the stall looks active. It is often where the tourist-vs-local gap becomes most obvious.
